scope.allocation: new buffers and replacement releases; CPU zeroing included only for fresh_pretouched; pipelines never recreated
scope.cold: first measured submission per case; no unmeasured GPU warmups; only ordinal 0 is process-first; fresh allocation does NOT guarantee cold physical pages
scope.encode_commit_wait: CPU wall including command creation, encoding, commit and wait; command autorelease drainage per-submission except explicit deferred-pool controls
scope.execution: canonical Sort(8 digit bits, 8 items/thread), then maintain_directory; one command buffer; same retained pipelines throughout
scope.faults: libc getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) CPU process minor/major fault deltas, NOT GPU faults and NOT evidence of disk I/O; phases include all process threads
scope.gpu_timestamp_ms: completed command buffer GPUEndTime minus GPUStartTime; not CPU wall
scope.input: deterministic SplitMix64 full-u32 keys with deliberate duplicate keys; independent full-u32 nonmonotonic payloads; identical unsorted input every submission
scope.medians: componentwise medians of the odd warmed sample count, excluding first measured cold submission; not sums of medians
scope.phase_faults: before/after snapshots; disabled phases are zero; GPU timestamps have no separate CPU fault interval; no counter failures ignored
scope.readback: full output and directory copied into preallocated CPU storage; only readback cases read between submissions; other cases first read after every repetition
scope.residency: explicit create/add/commit/requestResidency; prep is a hint and may leave deferred work; original tracked bindings remain; endResidency after completion
scope.resource_setup_once: initial per-mode buffers, scratch resize, input upload, optional persistent residency; separate from builds, including for fresh cases
scope.storage: shared, default CPU cache, default tracked hazards, direct encoder buffer bindings
scope.topology: distinct immutable-source input, output, radix-12 directory, radix scratch, every hierarchical scan level; same sizes/count per row size
scope.total_build: enclosing wall/fault snapshot of allocation, upload, residency preparation, encode/commit/wait, optional readback, per-build residency release; includes phase instrumentation; excludes validation and one-time setup; deferred pool drainage reported separately at mode end
scope.validation: full stable row equality against CPU stable sort and all 4097 exact directory offsets; each readback round and every mode end; excluded from total build
scope.warm: subsequent submissions; fresh cases still replace their declared buffers each round
